title: The Hollow Loom
html:
Sorn the Loomkeeper holds Tessa's equipment beneath his workshop.

About

Given byTessa Reed
Level25
LengthLong
KindSide
Quest points3

What you need

  • Spider Friend Equipment Roll ×1

Steps

  1. Talk to Tessa Reed (outdoors around 886, 60) to get the quest.
  2. Defeat 8 Loom Receiving Guards (8) inside The Hollow Loom
  3. Speak with Ivo Sedge inside The Hollow Loom
  4. Defeat 9 Loom Nest Spiders (9) inside The Hollow Loom
  5. Defeat Sorn the Loomkeeper inside The Hollow Loom
    Return Tessa's equipment roll - Spider Friend Equipment Roll at 886, 60

Rewards

Reward
Gold800
Character XP40,000
Quest points3

What Tessa Reed says

Ivo Sedge: The receiving guards are gone? Then I can get out through the workshop. I'll wait on this landing until it's safe to cross the holding floor.

Ivo Sedge: Sorn ships anything a buyer will pay for. He keeps Tessa's equipment in his workroom, two floors below this one. The nesting cavern between here and there holds nine spiders he uses to guard his nursery. Clear them out before facing him, or he can carry on with another shipment. Give Tessa my regards.

Tessa Reed: My feeding tongs are still here, and the brushes. I thought Sorn would have thrown them away.

Tessa Reed: These tools will make caring for her easier. Her leg can bear weight again, and Sorn won't be taking her back.

Handing it in

"These tools will make caring for her easier. Her leg can bear weight again, and Sorn won't be taking her back."
